description: The finite Boolean constraint test returns true exactly when each constraint body fails containment in the supplied finite set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.constraintsPass_iff.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α)) (X : Finset α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.constraintsPass Γ X = true ↔ ∀ r ∈ Γ, r.head = none → ¬r.body ⊆ X
